subject: Extracting  fitted scores from crossvalidation based on diagnosis factor

messages.author: d9399aa1f4bbe32d
messages.subject: Extracting  fitted scores from crossvalidation based on diagnosis factor
parts:
Hi Kylie,

I am working with a  data set with 5 merged files( run1, ... , run5) . Each previously individual file contains 2 tissue sections (1 healthy, 1 tumor) with their added diagnosis factor. I performed  cross validation (PLS-DA) on the merged data set.

Now I would like to get a median value for the fitted scores from each individual tissue section ( run1_healthy, run1_tumor, run2_healthy, ... , run5_tumor)

As each sample contains scores from two samples, I am struggling to get the fitted scores separated.

Is there a way to extract the values based on the diagnosis factor assigned to the pixels.


Best wishes,

Uwe

messages.author: d9399aa1f4bbe32d
messages.subject: Re: Extracting fitted scores from crossvalidation based on diagnosis factor
parts:
Hi
I guess I found a way but it seems quite tedious:

run1_values<-as.data.frame(my_data@resultData$`run1`@resultData$`ncomp = 20`$fitted)
run1_values$diagnosis<-( my_data @resultData$ `run1`  @resultData$`ncomp = 20`$y)
summary( run1_values  [ run1_values $y=="healthy",])
summary( run1_values  [ run1_values $y=="tumor",])  

maybe there is an easier way...

best wishes,
Uwe
